items.headline: Monangai hyperextends his knee and his Week 1 is in doubt
items.summary: He was hurt in practice and is expected to miss several weeks. If he is not ready for the opener, D'Andre Swift inherits an even bigger role in Chicago's offense — the kind of volume move that does change a lineup.

items.headline: Kittle opens on the PUP list after the Achilles, targeting Melbourne
items.summary: He tore the tendon in the 2025 playoffs and opens on the PUP list. He says he wants to play Week 1 in Melbourne against the Rams. At 32 and with that injury, the player's timeline and the medical staff's rarely match.

items.headline: Higgins out for the season with a torn ACL
items.summary: Out for the season. His targets split between Nico Collins, Dalton Schultz and Tank Dell, which is one of the cleaner redistributions a long absence leaves behind.

items.headline: Hubbard is dealing with a hamstring issue but will be ready for the opener
items.summary: His coach sounds confident about having him for September 13 against Chicago. It fits what was already reported about Jonathon Brooks earning reps: Carolina's carry split is still open.

items.headline: Burden is risky at his ADP and Odunze benefits ten picks later
items.summary: With Burden out of the preseason with the groin, ADP analysis flags him as risky around pick 58, while Odunze — who goes about ten picks later — gains. This is exactly the pair where this board disagrees most with consensus.
